<br><br>


::: {#hero-heading}

We build the software infrastructure to hardwire UK Exascale computing directly to beamlines. We replace deterministic testing schedules with autonomous, AI-driven control loops that navigate the search space of material degradation in real-time.

[X-ray fluorescence map of a Zn-ion battery cathode (V K-edge in red, Zn K-edge in blue), 100 nm pixel size.]{.image-caption}

A joint research group between the [University of Greenwich](https://www.gre.ac.uk/) and the [Rutherford Appleton Laboratory](https://www.ukri.org/about-us/stfc/locations/rutherford-appleton-laboratory/). Part of [M34Impact](https://www.gre.ac.uk/research/activity/m34impact/), funded by the [Faraday Institution](https://www.faraday.ac.uk/) and [STFC](https://www.ukri.org/councils/stfc/).

:::

## News

**Apr 2026** — [PhD position open](/opportunities/#phd-sdm): *The Self-Driving Microscope*. Applications close 17 April.

**Mar 2026** — Jon Valijonov's first preprint: [D2IM-Strain](/publication/2026-03-31-d2im-strain-bone/) on direct strain field prediction in bone.

**Feb 2026** — [Fluid inclusions in natron](/publication/2026-02-19-natron-fluid-inclusions-enceladus/) submitted to Nature Portfolio — first observation of fluid inclusions in a mineral predicted on Enceladus.

**Jan 2026** — Two arXiv preprints: the [BASE Scale](/publication/2025-12-29-base-scale-autonomous-facilities/) taxonomy for autonomous facilities and [Heuristic Operando Experimentation](/publication/2025-12-29-autonomous-battery-operando/).

**Sep 2025** — BASE Lab launched at the University of Greenwich as part of M34Impact.

**Feb 2025** — Calum Green's [multimodal synchrotron dataset](/publication/2025-02-24-multimodal-synchrotron-ml/) published in *Scientific Data*.
